verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's GitHub claims drop-in OpenAI compatibility, letting you swap providers without rewriting code. Its self-hosted proxy issues virtual keys and returns responses in OpenAI Chat Completions format, and a maintainer confirmed the proxy handles streaming and function-calling the same way as the openai-python SDK. missing for 10: explicit first-party docs showing that only the base_url and api_key change in existing OpenAI SDK code, and independent hands-on corroboration of the base-URL swap.

support.subject: As a developer, I can point existing OpenAI-compatible code at the gateway by changing only the base URL and key

citations.quote: Drop-in OpenAI compatibility — swap providers without rewriting your code
Every response follows the OpenAI Chat Completions format, regardless of provider.
Self-hosted LLM Gateway (Proxy) with virtual keys
proxy supports streaming and function-calling in the same way as the openai-python SDK
